description: This file defines an abstract Android activity class 'LockedActivity' that manages device lock/unlock behavior, including handling screen security and user authentication prompts.

classes.name: LockedActivity
classes.description: An abstract activity class that enforces device lock screen authentication and manages screen security settings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets exception handler, enforces screen security if preference is set, and prompts for unlock if activity is root.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks if activity is not root and prompts for unlock.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Updates last interaction timestamp if activity is root.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides back press to update last interaction.

methods.name: startActivityForResult
methods.description: Overrides to update last interaction before starting new activity.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Overrides to update last interaction before starting new activity.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from unlock activity, unlocking app or finishing based on result.

methods.name: askToUnlock
methods.description: Prompts the user to unlock the device if it is locked, using KeyguardManager.
